hints.title: Total Sum Aggregation
hints.text: Start by finding the total sum of all elements in the input array.

hints.title: Complementary Right Sum
hints.text: For each element, rightSum equals totalSum - leftSum - nums[i].

hints.title: Running Prefix Accumulator
hints.text: Maintain leftSum incrementally as you iterate and store the absolute difference |leftSum - rightSum|.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Difference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def leftRightDifference(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        total = sum(nums)
        left = 0
        ans = []
        for x in nums:
            right = total - left - x
            ans.append(abs(left - right))
            left += x
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating left and right sums from scratch for every index takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains a running prefix sum instead of recomputing range sums.
